name: Empty Blue Waterskin
summary: Brine sends the Empty Blue Waterskin north from the Barrens to gather sacred water. The liquid will help her prepare the draught needed to summon and appease the water spirit.

sections.title: A Sacred Vessel
sections.body: Brine gives the Empty Blue Waterskin to a shaman initiate at her hilltop hut in the southern Barrens. The vessel marks the final and most perilous gathering task of early training. To commune with the spirit of water, the initiate must seek pure, undisturbed sources across Kalimdor. The waterskin is meant for a secluded fountain deep within the Ruins of Stardust, along Ashenvale's contested borderlands.

sections.title: The Forest Fountain
sections.body: The initiate must leave the safety of Horde territory and travel into ancient groves guarded by nature beasts and night elves. At a fountain in the ruined sanctuary deep within the Ruins of Stardust, the waterskin is filled and becomes a Filled Blue Waterskin. With water samples from the Barrens and Tarren Mill, its contents let Brine brew the draught needed to summon and appease the elemental spirit of water.

faq.q: What is the Empty Blue Waterskin used for?
aliases: what does empty blue waterskin do
why do i have empty blue waterskin
faq.answer: The Empty Blue Waterskin carries water from the fountain deep within the Ruins of Stardust in Ashenvale back to Brine, who uses it to brew a draught of pure water.

aliases: where do you get blue waterskin
faq.answer: Brine gives you the waterskin at her hut in the southern Barrens, south of Camp Taurajo near the Razorfen border.

faq.q: Where must the waterskin be filled?
aliases: where to fill empty blue waterskin
faq.answer: Fill it at the central fountain deep within the Ruins of Stardust in south-western Ashenvale, just past Lake Mystral near the Stonetalon mountain ridge.

faq.q: Why does Brine need water from Ashenvale?
faq.answer: Brine seeks to make the purest vial of water known on Kalimdor. The untouched sacred wellsprings of the night elven ruins provide the pristine final component for communing with the elemental spirits of water.

angles.text: As a shaman, you carry and fill the waterskin as a vital step in mastering the spirits of water. Its pure liquid is needed to craft your permanent Water Totem.
As a member of the Horde, you must travel from the Barrens into hostile night elf territory in western Ashenvale to retrieve the water.
